notes: Guards who gets to say how a task ended: WorkActivity defers and the ledger narrates after assessing, and a verdict that does not contradict the provider still keeps the provider's own wording -- review is where every finished attempt lands on the way to the Accept gate, so reading it as disagreement would swap every successful report for a sentence about needing review. The contradicted variant, which is the 2026-07-31 defect, is NOT covered here yet: nine real runs failed to reach it. Asking for a shell command assumed acceptEdits denies shell, which it does not; a relative escape made the model reach for target="desktop", the staged-export path added precisely so that out-of-workspace delivery stops becoming a denied write; putting the escape first made the model drop cwd six runs running, because an utterance about workspace boundaries competes with the harness rule to echo one; and with the workspace established first, Locus simply resolved the outside absolute path into its own worktree and succeeded. The sandbox has made that failure mode genuinely hard to provoke, which is good for the product and inconvenient here. A reliable trigger is still owed.
